text_blocks.snippet: Morgellons disease is a controversial condition where individuals report experiencing crawling, stinging, or biting sensations under the skin, along with fibers or filamentous material emerging from the skin. It is not yet recognized as a distinct medical diagnosis by mainstream medicine. While some see it as a delusional parasitosis (a mental health condition where individuals falsely believe they are infested with parasites), others suggest it may be associated with Lyme disease or other tick-borne illnesses.
